title: Per-resource history-pruning limit must cover delete+recreate races for Watch
answers: Watch errors fetching previous state of a resource
jobs Watch stream fails after resource is deleted and recreated quickly
error getting previous value during Watch on provisioning jobs
why does pruning the kv history break Watch delete events
body:
Symptom: a Watch stream errors trying to load the previous version of a resource (via WrittenEvent.PreviousRV) shortly after that resource was deleted and quickly recreated.
Root cause: pkg/storage/unified/resource/pruner_history_limits.go customPrunerHistoryLimits had `provisioning.grafana.app/jobs` set to 1, so pruneEvents (storage_backend.go kvStorageBackend.pruneEvents) deleted the prior deleted-version data before a Watch consumer could read it.
Fix pattern: raise the per-resource entry in customPrunerHistoryLimits (LookupPrunerHistoryLimit) enough to survive the resource's observed recreate interval (e.g. jobs recreated ~hourly -> limit 3); a limit of 1 is only safe for resources nobody watches for history (e.g. historicjobs, terminal audit records).
Constraints: applies to any group/resource added to customPrunerHistoryLimits whose Watch consumers rely on PreviousRV/previous value; not needed for resources without such watchers.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource/pruner_history_limits.go customPrunerHistoryLimits entries and any resource watched via Watch() PreviousRV

search: Per-resource history-pruning limits in customPrunerHistoryLimits must survive a resource's delete-and-recreate interval; a limit of 1 is unsafe for watched resources. When limits are too low, Watch streams error trying to load WrittenEvent.PreviousRV after delete+recreate, because pruneEvents deletes prior deleted-version data before Watch consumers read it. Fix: raise the customPrunerHistoryLimits entry high enough for the resource's observed recreate interval (hourly recreation → limit ≥3); a limit of 1 is only safe for unwatched resources (e.g., historicjobs, terminal audits). Applies to any group/resource with Watch consumers relying on PreviousRV. Key locations: pkg/storage/unified/resource/pruner_history_limits.go:LookupPrunerHistoryLimit, customPrunerHistoryLimits, and pkg/storage/unified/resource/storage_backend.go:kvStorageBackend.pruneEvents.
